reviewed_hunks.quote: **Methods.** PRISMA 2020 systematic umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses, supplemented by landmark RCTs. PubMed (1,495-review corpus plus ten scoping searches), OpenAlex citation chasing, ClinicalTrials.gov, and Crossref metadata verification. 2,360 unique bibliographic records and 363 trial records were screened; 112 records (90 primary, 22 context) and 273 outcomes were extracted, including November 2026 updates of six gaming-disorder engagement records, three photosensitivity safety records, one gamification record, three incentive-design records, three goal-setting records, two retrieval-practice records, two habit records, one gamification-caution record, one planning-interventions record, two mental-contrasting records, one test-anxiety record, one interleaving record, one engagement-prompts record and one adherence record. Certainty is recorded as reported by the source review; independent GRADE was not performed.
